name: bifrost-cost-unpriced
description: Test 3 on Bifrost transports/v2.2.6, run through run-cost.sh with a throwaway key (limits in the run's NOTE.md and quota.json). Needs the test 3 window (README.md): test-claude-unpriced, an alias to the real Claude model whose canonical model_name has no price. Bifrost charges a budget only when cost > 0, so unpriced requests should never spend the $0.0001 budget: expect all of them answered, then priced Claude requests to spend it and be refused. RESULT (2026-10-24): wrong prediction. Bifrost priced the alias as claude-haiku-5-5, the model it resolves to, so the unpriced cases were charged and refused once the budget was spent; the 5 mismatches in the recorded run are that finding.
